notes: Names group vector-tile fragments for local search; they are not unique physical road identifiers.
Bounds are clipped to the configured city cutout. Center is a point on the longest retained straight segment, not an address or entrance.
Bridge/tunnel flags mean at least one grouped fragment has the corresponding source flag.
This is a display/search index, not a routing graph. Tile fragments can repeat across tile boundaries.
